title: Sweep prior-epic and design docs for legacy address-form references
description:
Update every prior-epic design/investigation doc and the invariants registry's own header comment that still illustrates addressing using the old kindless project form (`@/<self-id>`, e.g. `@/INV-01`, with no kind segment). This is documentation-hygiene blast radius for the uniform re-addressing migration: the kind-segmented parser (`@[<project>]/<kind>/<self-id>`) and the rule/gate item kinds have already landed elsewhere in this epic; these docs predate that work and now describe a superseded form as if it were current.

Files and edits:
- `dev/active/21558ace-invariants-registry.md:5` — "the `@/<self-id>` projection are the NEXT issue" -> name the current form `@/invariant/<self-id>`.
- `dev/active/21558ace-invariants-registry.md:16` — inline TOML example comment `# self-id; @/INV-01 is its qualified id` -> `@/invariant/INV-01`.
- `dev/active/21558ace-invariants-registry.md:22` — "The project-scoped qualified id `@/<id>` is derived" -> `@/invariant/<id>`.
- `dev/active/90a2dbfd-kinds-over-sources.md:12` — "qualified ids (`<issue>/REQ-01`, `@/INV-01`)" -> `@/invariant/INV-01` (the issue-scoped `<issue>/REQ-01` example is the still-valid sugar form; leave it).
- `dev/active/90a2dbfd-kinds-over-sources.md:72-74` — comparison table: `invariant (`@/INV-01`)` -> `@/invariant/INV-01`; `ADR / project decision (`@/D-05`)` -> `@/decision/D-05`; `program risk (`@/RISK-01`)` -> `@/risk/RISK-01`.
- `dev/active/90a2dbfd-kinds-over-sources.md:82` — "cites `@/DEF-assignee-format`" -> `@/definition/Assignee` (the shipped `definition` kind's id-pattern is a single capitalized word, `[A-Z][a-z]+`, per `.jit/config.toml:141`; `docs/reference/glossary.md` defines `Assignee` under `## Core Concepts`, matching that pattern — `DEF-assignee-format` never matched the shipped pattern, so this also fixes a stale example, not just the address form).
- `dev/active/90a2dbfd-kinds-over-sources.md:117` — Mermaid node label `ITEMS["AddressableItem  @/<self-id>"]` -> `@/<kind>/<self-id>`.
- `dev/active/90a2dbfd-kinds-over-sources.md:208` — "field mapping yields `@/<self-id>` items (REQ-02)" -> `@/<kind>/<self-id>`.
- `dev/studies/addressing-v2-rule-gate-items.md:191` — open point 11 ("Whether old `@/INV-*` and `<issue>/REQ-*` addresses must keep resolving...") is now resolved; annotate it as resolved, citing decision D11 ("clean cut, no shim") recorded in `dev/active/2821e177-2d2d-4b25-b64a-4f38723e7fe6-plan.md` (search "D11 — Backward-compat window"), instead of leaving it phrased as an open question.
- `.jit/invariants.toml:2-3` — header comment "Each entry is a project-scoped addressable item at `@/<id>`; link work to one with an `enforces:@/<id>` label." -> `@/invariant/<id>` and `enforces:@/invariant/<id>` respectively.

None of these files are `jit validate`-checked data (confirmed in `dev/active/2821e177-investigation.md`'s REQ-08 finding) — this is pure prose/comment hygiene, no functional or schema change.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: every listed line in `dev/active/21558ace-invariants-registry.md`, `dev/active/90a2dbfd-kinds-over-sources.md`, and `.jit/invariants.toml`'s header comment shows the kind-segmented form (`@/<kind>/<self-id>`) in place of the old kindless form. Verify with `grep -n '@/[A-Z]' dev/active/21558ace-invariants-registry.md dev/active/90a2dbfd-kinds-over-sources.md .jit/invariants.toml`, which must return zero matches (the new form's kind segment is lowercase, e.g. `@/invariant/INV-01`, so this pattern only matches the old bare form).
- [hard] REQ-02: `dev/studies/addressing-v2-rule-gate-items.md:191`'s backward-compat open point is annotated as resolved, citing decision D11.
- [hard] REQ-03: `jit validate` (or `./scripts/jit-validate.sh`) still exits clean after the edits, confirming the `.jit/invariants.toml` comment-only change did not break TOML parsing or schema loading.
